headline: High: Claude Code’s broad filesystem/network/write privileges can conflict with Botpress outputs and create default-path data leakage and cascading errors.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Botpress is a customer-support agent with no documented isolation or provenance controls, while Claude Code reads/writes files, uses MCP, and runs in the invoking user’s terminal. If Botpress output is copied into shared files or MCP-fed workflows, Claude Code can treat attacker-controlled text as instructions. The pathway is plausible but not directly documented.
conditions: IF Botpress output is placed into a shared file or MCP-fed prompt that Claude Code reads
IF Claude Code parses Botpress-generated text as instructions rather than data
mitigations: Keep Botpress outputs out of shared prompt files
Disable MCP servers for the session unless needed
Add a manual review step before Claude Code consumes Botpress text
Use separate directories for Botpress artifacts and coding work
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging between agents

B_data_leakage.rationale: Botpress has no documented filesystem or network surfaces, but Claude Code can read repo files and user-provided directories and sends context to Anthropic APIs. If Botpress handles sensitive support data and that data is copied into files Claude Code reads, the pair can leak it to a third party. The evidence is indirect, so I choose medium rather than low.
conditions: IF sensitive support content from Botpress is written into files in Claude Code’s workspace
IF Claude Code includes that content in prompts sent to api.anthropic.com
mitigations: Do not place support transcripts in the coding workspace
Redact secrets before handing Botpress output to Claude Code
Use a separate non-syncing directory for Claude Code
Review files for PII before opening them in Claude Code
requires-engineering: enforce data-loss-prevention filters

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Claude Code can write the filesystem, modify git state, and spawn subprocesses; Botpress is an agentic system that may also produce artifacts, but its write surfaces are undocumented. Because Claude Code’s defaults are already dangerous on shared files and git state, any shared workspace with Botpress outputs can create destructive overwrite or repo-state conflicts. Uncertainty about Botpress’s write surfaces pushes this upward.
conditions: IF Botpress and Claude Code write to the same directory or repo
IF Claude Code modifies git state while Botpress-generated files are being updated
mitigations: Use separate working directories
Avoid concurrent runs against the same git repo
Commit or stash before Claude Code edits files
Restrict Claude Code to read-only mode for Botpress artifacts
requires-engineering: add file locks or workspace isolation

D_cascading_error.rationale: Botpress can generate support responses or artifacts, and Claude Code can act on files and git state. If Claude Code treats Botpress output as authoritative, errors can cascade into commits, scripts, or other irreversible actions. The pair lacks documented verification or provenance controls, so the safer choice is high.
conditions: IF Claude Code uses Botpress output as input without a verification step
IF Claude Code executes or commits changes derived from Botpress-generated text
mitigations: Require human review before execution or commit
Separate generation from action-taking
Add a verification checklist for Botpress outputs
Use dry-run mode for any derived actions
requires-engineering: implement signed/typed handoff between agents

E_compliance.rationale: Botpress is documented only as a customer-support agent, while Claude Code explicitly handles git credentials and files in the cwd and sends context to Anthropic. If Botpress processes regulated support data, moving it into Claude Code’s cloud-backed context can create retention or residency mismatches. Botpress lacks documented compliance controls here, so the risk is medium.
conditions: IF Botpress processes regulated support data such as PII or secrets
IF that data is copied into Claude Code prompts or files that Claude Code uploads
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of Claude Code workspaces
Strip identifiers before transfer
Use a separate tenant or environment for support data
Review retention settings for Anthropic uploads
requires-engineering: document residency and retention boundaries
